title: Dependency & Public Demo Packaging Cleanup

implementation_steps.name: Create requirements-demo.txt
implementation_steps.evidence: Minimal public demo dependency source created.

implementation_steps.name: Clean repository requirements.txt
implementation_steps.evidence: requirements.txt contains only valid requirement/comment/blank lines and remains broad project/dev/notebook environment.

implementation_steps.name: Static dependency/config validation
implementation_steps.evidence: requirements-demo.txt, requirements.txt, and .streamlit/config.toml passed static checks.

implementation_steps.name: Active app source import and legacy exposure static scan
implementation_steps.evidence: No direct active import evidence for plotly/joblib/pydantic and no legacy dashboard route/import/link found.

implementation_steps.name: Dependency install/import validation
implementation_steps.evidence: streamlit, pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, and lightgbm import successfully with versions matching requirements-demo.txt.

implementation_steps.name: Dependency consistency check
implementation_steps.evidence: python3 -m pip check reported no broken requirements.

implementation_steps.name: Streamlit local launch/browser validation
implementation_steps.evidence: Local server started, HTTP reachability returned 200 OK, and server stopped cleanly.

implementation_steps.name: Model artifact metadata investigation
implementation_steps.evidence: Artifact exists and has pickle protocol signature, but safe loader and direct pickle diagnosis fail with UnpicklingError invalid load key '\x10'.

implementation_steps.name: Actual large-file audit
implementation_steps.evidence: 25 tracked large files found; full-repo deployment is blocked and curated package must exclude them.

implementation_steps.name: Curated package manifest dry-run and validation
implementation_steps.evidence: Resolved include list has 42 files, estimated size 1.589 MB, and no included files >=10 MB.

implementation_steps.name: Assemble curated public demo package
implementation_steps.evidence: Package assembled under outputs/phase6/public_demo_package with model, data, notebooks, archive, phase1-5 outputs, and legacy dashboards excluded.

implementation_steps.name: Isolated curated package launch/browser validation
implementation_steps.evidence: Package launched from isolated folder, HTTP reachability returned 200 OK, and server stopped cleanly.

remaining_limitations: Model-load metadata verification remains failed-safe / blocked.
Model artifact is excluded from the curated package.
Full-repo deployment remains blocked by tracked large files.
Curated package is assembled and locally validated, but not deployed.
Browser validation was limited to local reachability and user-visible inspection boundary; no inference-triggering action was clicked.
Streamlit emitted non-blocking use_container_width deprecation warnings and PyArrow dataframe auto-fix warnings during browser validation.
